abAt: inside / outside / on the rim; overlapping zones: the nearest centre relative to its radius
readSaved: nil when the game script cannot be read; never throws
validate: cleaned copies (extra keys dropped), fixed by_ab order
validate: optional id / pair labels kept when well-formed, dropped (not the zone) otherwise
validate: ring layout variants accepted; by_ab lists them after sl_keeplights in their order, each only when present
validate: sl_classic accepted (the classic phase plan for A/B twins); by_ab adds it only when present, last
validate: sl_exitfan accepted (exit-lane fan); by_ab adds sl_exitfan only when present, after sl_lock
validate: sl_fan accepted (fan mode); old payloads (game / sl / sl_phases) unchanged; by_ab adds sl_fan only when present
validate: sl_keeplights accepted (SL-1); by_ab adds sl_keeplights only when present, after sl_exitfan
validate: sl_lock accepted (free kerb turn locked); by_ab adds sl_lock only when present, after sl_fan
world.exitFan: a list frozen into the world (the automatic pass's job zones) wins over W.zones
zoneAt / idOf (SL-3): the zone record a point lies in and its id label
